donors.observation: seven Secrets of Strixhaven prepare creatures of the Owner's collection sat in the set's unfinished list; Coercive Impetus gave +2/+2 instead of +1/+1; and a creature that enters prepared lost its prepare spell copy at once, because BecomePreparedSourceEffect linked the copy to the permanent with the zone change counter of the replacement step, one lower than the final value

architecture_freeze_binding.why: the Owner-signed Architecture Freeze (2026-10-10) is bound to the epoch it was signed against; a pin move is not a re-signing. architecture_freeze.current_qualification stays on the epoch it names until PB-03 runs on the Lab main merge commit of this repin, AF11 is re-adjudicated for this pin and the freeze record is re-assembled.

current_boundary.how: PB-03 workflow_dispatch on the exact Lab main merge commit of this repin, sealed as a new epoch, then AF11 re-adjudicated for this pin. No current-boundary epoch exists for this pin yet, and none may be written by this repin.
